Interface IIngredientComponentCapabilityAttacher<T,M>

Type Parameters:
T - The instance type.
M - The matching condition parameter.
All Known Implementing Classes:
IngredientComponentCapabilityAttacherAdapter
public interface IIngredientComponentCapabilityAttacher<T,M>
Instances of this interfaces can be used to attach a ICapabilityProvider to instances of IngredientComponent that are selected by name.
